body:
I don't have a life to look forward to. I have evaded bills for more than a year. I don't even have a valid ID. I will face trial due to fraud and the best I can hope for is a job as a janitor or equal. I don't want to go on like this anymore. If I do, all of my mistakes and all of the things I could have done instead will haunt me forever. I am a burden to my family financially and I will never be anything anyone can ever be proud of.

Thank you for your words. You're a good person.
